title: 🌨️Cloak of Peace
description: The resource pack [Cloak of Peace] replaces all player capes in the game with its own custom cape. This resource pack features the Cape of Peace.
body:
The resource pack [Cloak of Peace] replaces all player capes in the game with its own custom cape. This resource pack features the Cape of Peace.

To make it work, you need to enable: **[Amazing Graphics > AMAZING!]**
